name: SBH
recent: SBH Marine 近期公告集中在大股东兼集团董事经理 Tan Boo Nam 于闭门期内的连续增持，11 月 6 日至 18 日多笔交易合计增持约 402 万股，持股比例升至 32.447%。同期公司未公布新合约或企业活动。最新季度（2026 年 6 月 30 日止）营收环比增长 9.5%，但同比减少 3.1%，净利 50.8 万令吉。
notable: 集团董事经理 Tan Boo Nam 于 11 月 6 日至 18 日期间多次在公开市场增持公司股份，最新持股比例升至 32.447%。
risks: Tan Boo Nam 在闭门期内多次申报增持，相关交易需留意是否符合闭门期交易规定。
earnings: 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度营收 4294.4 万令吉，环比增长 9.5%，同比减少 3.1%；净利 50.8 万令吉，同比增长 7.6%，净利率 1.2%，较上一季度的 -6.3% 转正。

recent_en: SBH Marine's recent announcements centre on consecutive acquisitions by Group Managing Director and substantial shareholder Tan Boo Nam during the closed period, with multiple trades from 6 to 18 November totalling about 4.02 million shares and lifting his stake to 32.447%. No new contracts or corporate exercises were announced in the same period. In the latest quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue rose 9.5% QoQ but fell 3.1% YoY, with net profit of RM508,000.
notable_en: Group Managing Director Tan Boo Nam acquired shares in the open market multiple times between 6 and 18 November, with his latest stake rising to 32.447%.
risks_en: Tan Boo Nam reported multiple acquisitions during the closed period; the compliance of these trades with closed-period dealing rules warrants attention.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM42.944 million, up 9.5% QoQ but down 3.1% YoY; net profit was RM508,000, up 7.6% YoY, with a net margin of 1.2% versus -6.3% in the prior quarter.
